=== usage
[exit 1]
A small tool for schedule.yaml + the launchd scheduler, so you don't have to remember launchctl syntax or hand-edit yaml.

To add a schedule, just edit schedule.yaml and add a job entry. No need for this tool or for
launchd: the next scheduler.py tick (within 15 minutes) picks it up.
This tool only does what needs a command to remember, or risks breaking the yaml by hand:
pausing/resuming a single job, and turning the whole scheduler on/off and checking its state.

Usage:
  schedulectl list                list every job and its state (enabled/paused, time, command)
  schedulectl pause <name>        pause a job (its settings stay, resume brings it back)
  schedulectl resume <name>       resume a job
  schedulectl status              whether the scheduler itself (launchd) is running + the latest runs
  schedulectl logs [name] [n]     print the last n lines of a log (default scheduler.log; with name, that job's log for today)
  schedulectl run <name>          run a job once now (like Desktop's "Run now") and record it as run today
                                   (an LLM job is then not run again by the schedule the same day). Runs through launchd in
                                   the user's desktop session: under SSH the keychain can't be read and claude is logged out
  schedulectl stop                stop the scheduler completely (launchctl bootout; schedule.yaml untouched)
  schedulectl start               start the scheduler again (launchctl bootstrap)
  schedulectl models               the model each decision point actually uses, and where it comes from (llm.model_for and
                                   hub.json's llm section)
  schedulectl set-model <point|state|index|consolidate> <model|default>
                                   write into hub.json llm.points (default = drop the pin, back to the group's default);
                                   state = the single-project STATE.md points, index = the cross-project index.md and weekly
                                   report, consolidate = the cleanup pass
=== bad command

=== list
[exit None]
[enabled] nightly              daily 03:00  echo nightly
[paused] weekly               weekly on mon,thu 07:00  echo w
[enabled] quarterly            yearly in month 1,month 4,month 7,month 10 day 1 09:00 (at most 2 tries a day)  echo q
[enabled] monthly              monthly on day 1,day 15 10:00 (until <DATE>)  echo m
[enabled] often                daily every 15 min (08:00-23:00)  echo o
[enabled] hourly               daily every 60 min  echo h
[enabled] demo/job             daily 05:30  cd /x && echo j
